image_description: Two tabby cats interacting on furniture. One cat is perched on a light wooden stool/chair back, leaning forward to groom or nuzzle the second cat, which is standing on a red surface (possibly a small table or box) with its back arched. The background features a Christmas tree and holiday decorations.

The vertical slats of the wooden stool show minor inconsistency in parallelism and thickness, suggesting slight geometric warping common in AI backgrounds.
